"""Exact installed overlays: frozen real case reads and disposable PostgreSQL guards."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import UTC,datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
INPUT=json.loads((ROOT/"input.json").read_text())
os.umask(0o077)
def run(args,timeout=120,strip=True):
    p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
    if p.returncode:
        frames=re.findall(r'File "([^"]+)", line ([0-9]+)',p.stderr)
        errors=re.findall(r"^([A-Za-z.]+Error|AssertionError):([^\n]*)",p.stderr,re.M)
        raise RuntimeError(json.dumps({"command":args[0],"errors":errors[-2:],"frames":[(Path(a).name,b) for a,b in frames[-5:]]}))
    return p.stdout.strip() if strip else p.stdout
module_root="/app/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/quant_company"
targets,images={},{}
for key,names in {"worker":["admission"],"maintenance":["admission","github","runner","investigation"]}.items():
    c=json.loads(run(["docker","inspect","quant-company-"+key+"-1"]))[0]
    assert c["State"]["Running"]
    labels=c["Config"]["Labels"]
    targets[key]={"name":c["Name"].lstrip("/"),"id":c["Id"],"base_image_id":c["Image"],"image_tag":c["Config"]["Image"],
                  "project":labels["com.docker.compose.project"],"service":labels["com.docker.compose.service"],
                  "compose_files":labels["com.docker.compose.project.config_files"],"envfile":"/var/lib/quant-company/config/runtime.env"}
    for name in names:
        source=run(["docker","exec",targets[key]["name"],"python","-c","from pathlib import Path;print(Path("+repr(module_root+"/maintenance/"+name+".py")+").read_text(),end='')"],strip=False)
        assert hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest()==INPUT["base_modules"][name], "Actual source mismatch: "+key+"/"+name
        assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/"payload"/(name+".py")).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==INPUT["candidate_modules"][name]
        ast.parse((ROOT/"payload"/(name+".py")).read_bytes())
        (ROOT/"payload"/("baseline-"+name+".py")).write_text(source)
        (ROOT/"payload"/("baseline-"+name+".py")).chmod(0o644)
    tag="quant-company-maintainer-continuity-"+key+":"+INPUT["patch_commit"][:7]
    file=ROOT/("Dockerfile."+key)
    file.write_text("FROM "+targets[key]["image_tag"]+"\n"+"".join("COPY --chmod=0644 payload/"+n+".py "+module_root+"/maintenance/"+n+".py\n" for n in names))
    base=json.loads(run(["docker","image","inspect",targets[key]["image_tag"]]))[0]
    assert base["Id"]==c["Image"]
    run(["docker","build","--network","none","-f",str(file),"-t",tag,str(ROOT)],180)
    image=json.loads(run(["docker","image","inspect",tag]))[0]
    for field in ("User","Entrypoint","Cmd","WorkingDir","Env"):
        assert base["Config"][field]==image["Config"][field]
    images[key]={"tag":tag,"id":image["Id"]}

def probe(image,service):
    env=dict(p.split("=",1) for p in service["Config"]["Env"])
    network=next(n for n in service["NetworkSettings"]["Networks"] if n.endswith("_core"))
    args=["docker","create","--pull","never","--read-only","--memory","512m","--cpus","0.5","--pids-limit","128",
          "--cap-drop","ALL","--security-opt","no-new-privileges:true","--user",service["Config"]["User"],
          "--tmpfs","/tmp:size=64m,mode=1777","--entrypoint","python","--network",network,
          "--mount","type=bind,src="+str(ROOT/"continuity-probe.py")+",dst=/opt/probe.py,readonly"]
    for pair in service["Config"]["Env"]:
        args+=["--env",pair]
    for m in service["Mounts"]:
        if m["Destination"] in {env["ROLES_FILE"],env["DATABASE_PASSWORD_FILE"],"/run/secrets/maintenance_github_key"} or m["Destination"].startswith("/etc/quant-company/"):
            assert m["Type"]=="bind"
            args+=["--mount","type=bind,src="+m["Source"]+",dst="+m["Destination"]+",readonly"]
    cid=run(args+[image,"/opt/probe.py"])
    try:
        for name in service["NetworkSettings"]["Networks"]:
            if name!=network:
                run(["docker","network","connect",name,cid])
        return json.loads(run(["docker","start","-a",cid],300))
    finally:
        run(["docker","rm","-f",cid])
service=json.loads(run(["docker","inspect",targets["maintenance"]["name"]]))[0]
baseline=probe(service["Image"],service)
candidate=probe(images["maintenance"]["id"],service)
comparison={"baseline":baseline,"candidate":candidate}
(ROOT/"comparison-attempt.json").write_text(json.dumps(comparison,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(comparison),flush=True)
assert not baseline["frozen_context"]["all_ranges_visible"]
assert candidate["frozen_context"]["all_ranges_visible"]
assert candidate["requested_file"]["context_with_requested_test"]["all_ranges_visible"]
assert candidate["filename_lookup_returns_requested_code"]

store_source=run(["docker","exec",targets["maintenance"]["name"],"python","-c",
    "from pathlib import Path;print(Path("+repr(module_root+"/maintenance/store.py")+").read_text(),end='')"],strip=False)
store_sha=hashlib.sha256(store_source.encode()).hexdigest()
assert store_sha=="9cf9206a3d53d04d9eb1cd7bd5a56cafb14ce99c33f528f1df6be607e59ad5c0"
(ROOT/"payload"/"qualified-store.py").write_text(store_source)
(ROOT/"payload"/"qualified-store.py").chmod(0o644)
qual_tag="quant-company-maintainer-continuity-qualification:"+INPUT["patch_commit"][:7]
(ROOT/"Dockerfile.guard").write_text("FROM "+images["worker"]["tag"]+"\nCOPY --chmod=0644 payload/qualified-store.py "+module_root+"/maintenance/store.py\n")
run(["docker","build","--network","none","-f",str(ROOT/"Dockerfile.guard"),"-t",qual_tag,str(ROOT)],180)
network="maintainer-continuity-qual-"+INPUT["patch_commit"][:7]
pg_name=network+"-pg"
pg_image=json.loads(run(["docker","inspect","quant-company-postgres-1"]))[0]["Image"]
assert not run(["docker","network","ls","--filter","name=^"+network+"$","--format","{{.ID}}"])
created=False
try:
    run(["docker","network","create","--internal",network])
    run(["docker","run","-d","--name",pg_name,"--pull","never","--network",network,
         "--memory","512m","--cpus","0.5","--pids-limit","128","--tmpfs","/var/lib/postgresql/data:size=256m,mode=0700",
         "--env","POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD=trust",pg_image])
    created=True
    for _ in range(30):
        if subprocess.run(["docker","exec",pg_name,"pg_isready","-U","postgres"],capture_output=True).returncode==0:
            break
        time.sleep(1)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError("Disposable PostgreSQL not ready")
    guards=json.loads(run(["docker","run","--rm","--pull","never","--network",network,"--read-only",
         "--memory","512m","--cpus","0.5","--pids-limit","128","--cap-drop","ALL","--security-opt","no-new-privileges:true",
         "--tmpfs","/tmp:size=64m,mode=1777","--env","QUALIFICATION_PG="+pg_name,
         "--mount","type=bind,src="+str(ROOT/"revision-probe-v3.py")+",dst=/opt/revision-probe.py,readonly",
         "--mount","type=bind,src="+str(ROOT/"payload"/"baseline-admission.py")+",dst=/opt/baseline-admission.py,readonly",
         "--entrypoint","python",qual_tag,"/opt/revision-probe.py"],180))
finally:
    if created:
        run(["docker","rm","-f",pg_name])
    run(["docker","network","rm",network])
receipt={"captured_at":datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),"patch_commit":INPUT["patch_commit"],"targets":targets,"images":images,
         "base_modules":INPUT["base_modules"],"candidate_modules":INPUT["candidate_modules"],"comparison":comparison,
         "revision_guard":guards,"guard_store_sha256":store_sha,"temporary_database_and_network_removed":True,"model_calls":0,"production_database_writes":0,
         "image_execution_configuration_unchanged":True,"independent_source_changes_preserved":True}
(ROOT/"qualification.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(receipt))

import copy,hashlib,json,os
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import quote
import psycopg
from psycopg.rows import dict_row
from quant_company.maintenance.investigation import inspection_context,inspect_code
from quant_company.maintenance.policy import Triage,CodeQuery,MaintenanceConfig,digest
from quant_company.maintenance.runner import proposal_material,diagnostic_history,repository_prompt_paths
from quant_company.maintenance.github import GitHub,blob_sha
job_id="c7d07401-ef8a-5d16-96f5-b6048b16dd1b"
password=Path(os.environ["DATABASE_PASSWORD_FILE"]).read_text().strip()
url="postgresql://"+quote(os.environ.get("DATABASE_USER","company"),safe="")+":"+quote(password,safe="")+"@postgres:5432/"+quote(os.environ.get("DATABASE_NAME","quant_company"),safe="")
with psycopg.connect(url,row_factory=dict_row,connect_timeout=5) as conn:
    conn.execute("SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY")
    job=conn.execute("SELECT payload,md5(to_jsonb(j)::text) digest FROM maintenance_jobs j WHERE id=%s",(job_id,)).fetchone()
    calls=conn.execute("SELECT id,request,md5(to_jsonb(c)::text) digest FROM maintenance_calls c WHERE job_id=%s ORDER BY created_at,id",(job_id,)).fetchall()
    assert len(calls)==5
    payload=job["payload"]
    original=json.loads(calls[-1]["request"]["prompt"].split("EVIDENCE JSON:\n",1)[1])
    repo=conn.execute("SELECT files,metadata FROM repository_evidence WHERE commit=%s",(payload["snapshot"]["commit"],)).fetchone()
    def material_for(value):
        inspection=inspection_context(value)
        material={k:v for k,v in original.items() if not k.startswith("prompt_")}
        material.update(inspection)
        material["saved_inspection_requests"]=list({digest(q):q for r in value["investigation_requests"] for q in r.get("requests",[])}.values())
        material["history"]=diagnostic_history(payload)
        material["current_implementation"]=payload["diagnosis"]
        material["editable_paths"]=payload["snapshot"]["paths"]
        material["repository_paths"]=repository_prompt_paths(payload["snapshot"]["entries"])
        return material
    def visible(rows):
        return {(r["path"],line) for r in rows for line in r.get("content","").splitlines()}
    def qualify(material, extra=None):
        raw=visible(material["investigated_code"])
        shown,prompt=proposal_material(material,Triage)
        actual=visible(shown["investigated_code"])
        ranges=[]
        for path,start,count in [
            ("src/quant_company/maintenance/requests.py",40,213),
            ("src/quant_company/maintenance/cases.py",50,162),
            ("src/quant_company/company.py",870,90),
        ] + ([extra] if extra else []):
            expected={p for p in raw if p[0]==path and p[1].split(": ",1)[0].isdecimal() and start<=int(p[1].split(": ",1)[0])<start+count}
            assert expected
            ranges.append({"path":path,"start":start,"stored_lines":len(expected),"visible_lines":len(expected&actual),"complete":expected<=actual})
        assert len(prompt)<=88000 and shown["requested_diagnosis"]==original["requested_diagnosis"]
        assert shown["observations"]==original["observations"]
        return {"ranges":ranges,"all_ranges_visible":all(r["complete"] for r in ranges),
                "prompt_characters":len(prompt),"prompt_sha256":hashlib.sha256(prompt.encode()).hexdigest(),
                "sections":{k:len(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False)) for k,v in shown.items()},
                "diagnostic_sections":{k:len(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False)) for k,v in shown.get("current_implementation",{}).items()},
                "history_sections":{k:len(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False)) for k,v in shown.get("history",{}).items()},
                "history_related":sum(r.get("key") in {x.get("key") for x in material["observations"]} for r in material.get("history",{}).get("evidence",[])),
                "raw_code_characters":sum(len(r.get("content","")) for r in material["investigated_code"]),
                "raw_exact_ranges":[{"path":q.get("path"),"start":q.get("start_line"),"count":q.get("line_count")} for q in material.get("saved_inspection_requests",[]) if q.get("path") and not q.get("query")]}
    result={"frozen_context":qualify(material_for(payload))}
    target="tests/test_maintenance_repair_path.py"
    assert target in payload["snapshot"]["entries"] and target not in repo["files"]
    if hasattr(GitHub,"read_inspection_files"):
        github=GitHub(MaintenanceConfig.model_validate_json(Path("/etc/quant-company/maintenance.json").read_text()))
        query=CodeQuery(path=target,start_line=1,line_count=250)
        assert any(q.get("path")==target for r in payload["investigation_requests"] for q in r["requests"])
        files,coverage=github.read_inspection_files(payload["snapshot"],[query],previous=repo["files"])
        assert target in files and blob_sha(files[target])==payload["snapshot"]["entries"][target]["sha"]
        assert coverage["read_bytes"]<=2000000
        class EvidenceOnly:
            def execute(self,statement,params):
                assert statement.startswith("SELECT files FROM repository_evidence") and params==(payload["snapshot"]["commit"],)
                return self
            def fetchone(self):
                return {"files":{**repo["files"],**files}}
        returned=inspect_code(EvidenceOnly(),payload["snapshot"],[query])
        assert returned[0]["path"]==target and returned[0]["content"]
        candidate=copy.deepcopy(payload)
        candidate["investigation_evidence"].extend(returned)
        result["requested_file"]={"path":target,"blob_sha":blob_sha(files[target]),"same_commit":True,
            "file_bytes":len(files[target].encode()),"read_bytes":coverage["read_bytes"],"fetched_files":coverage["fetched_files"],
            "stored_cache_unchanged":True,"inspection_consumer":"actual inspect_code with read-only in-memory exact-file adapter",
            "context_with_requested_test":qualify(material_for(candidate),(target,1,250))}
        searched=inspect_code(EvidenceOnly(),payload["snapshot"],[CodeQuery(query="test_maintenance_repair_path",line_count=120)])
        assert searched and searched[0]["path"]==target
        result["filename_lookup_returns_requested_code"]=True
    assert conn.execute("SELECT md5(to_jsonb(j)::text) digest FROM maintenance_jobs j WHERE id=%s",(job_id,)).fetchone()["digest"]==job["digest"]
    after=conn.execute("SELECT id,md5(to_jsonb(c)::text) digest FROM maintenance_calls c WHERE job_id=%s ORDER BY created_at,id",(job_id,)).fetchall()
    assert after==[{"id":c["id"],"digest":c["digest"]} for c in calls]
    assert digest(conn.execute("SELECT files,metadata FROM repository_evidence WHERE commit=%s",(payload["snapshot"]["commit"],)).fetchone())==digest(repo)
    result.update(original_job_unchanged=True,original_calls_unchanged=True,database_writes=0,model_calls=0)
    conn.rollback()
print(json.dumps(result))

"""Real disposable PostgreSQL; simulated owner/model records; zero inference or Slack writes."""
import json
import os
import types
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4

import psycopg
from psycopg.types.json import Jsonb

from quant_company.company import Company
from quant_company.config import Settings
from quant_company.contracts import AgentDecision, ProviderResponse, Role, ToolRequest
from quant_company.maintenance.policy import MaintenanceConfig
from quant_company.maintenance.store import Deferred, Store


PG = os.environ["QUALIFICATION_PG"]

def fixture(company_type, store_type):
    name = "qual_" + uuid4().hex
    with psycopg.connect(f"postgresql://postgres@{PG}/postgres", autocommit=True) as admin:
        admin.execute("CREATE DATABASE " + name + " TEMPLATE template0")
    settings = Settings(database_url=f"postgresql://postgres@{PG}/{name}", model_provider="fixture",
                        fixture_mode=True, slack_team_id="TTEST",
                        slack_allowed_users=["UHUMAN"], slack_allowed_channels=["CQUANT"])
    roles = {name: Role(id=name, name=name, mission="Synthetic fixture", model="fixture-model",
                        instructions="Synthetic fixture only", tools=["calculate", "maintenance_review"],
                        can_delegate_to=[], active=True) for name in ["director", "engineer"]}
    company = company_type(settings, roles)
    company.db.migrate()
    config = MaintenanceConfig(app_id=1, installation_id=2, private_key_file=Path("unused-fixture-key"),
                               allowed_owners=["UHUMAN"], enabled=True)
    store = store_type(company, config)
    store.initialize()
    project = company.ingest(event_key=str(uuid4()), owner="UHUMAN", text="Fixture owner maintenance request",
                             channel="CQUANT", thread_ts="fixture")
    def next_turn():
        with company.db.transaction() as conn:
            return str(conn.execute("SELECT id FROM turns WHERE task_id=%s AND status='queued'",
                                    (project["task_id"],)).fetchone()["id"])
    turn = next_turn()
    company.prepare_turn(turn)
    company.commit_turn(turn, ProviderResponse(request_id=turn, provider="fixture", decision=AgentDecision(
        say="Fixture tool", status="continue", tools=[ToolRequest(name="maintenance_review", arguments={})])))
    turn = next_turn()
    company.prepare_turn(turn)
    company.commit_turn(turn, ProviderResponse(request_id=turn, provider="fixture", decision=AgentDecision(
        say="Fixture receipt", status="complete")))
    store.prepare_review(store.next_job())
    return company, store, store.next_job()

def background(company):
    project = company.ingest(event_key=str(uuid4()), owner="UHUMAN", channel="CQUANT", text="Fixture background")
    with company.db.transaction() as conn:
        conn.execute("UPDATE tasks SET priority=100 WHERE id=%s", (project["task_id"],))
        return str(conn.execute("SELECT id FROM turns WHERE task_id=%s", (project["task_id"],)).fetchone()["id"])

import quant_company.maintenance.admission as admission
import types
base = types.ModuleType("baseline_admission")
base.__package__ = "quant_company.maintenance"
exec(compile(Path("/opt/baseline-admission.py").read_text(), "baseline_admission", "exec"), base.__dict__)
company, store, job = fixture(Company, Store)
call = store.prepare_call(job, "triage", "Fixture stale diagnostic reservation")
original = call["request"]
with company.db.transaction() as conn:
    conn.execute("UPDATE maintenance_jobs SET payload=jsonb_set(payload, '{diagnostic_revision}', '1'::jsonb) WHERE id=%s", (job["id"],))
work = background(company)
candidate_function = admission.owner_call_waiting
admission.owner_call_waiting = base.owner_call_waiting
try:
    assert company.prepare_turn(work)["reason"] == "owner_maintenance_request"
finally:
    admission.owner_call_waiting = candidate_function
assert company.prepare_turn(work)["state"] == "ready"
current = store.next_job()
new_call = store.prepare_call(current, "triage", "Fixture current diagnostic reservation")
assert "-r1-triage" in new_call["id"]
assert company.prepare_turn(background(company))["reason"] == "owner_maintenance_request"
with company.db.transaction() as conn:
    saved = conn.execute("SELECT request,response FROM maintenance_calls WHERE id=%s", (call["id"],)).fetchone()
    assert saved["request"] == original and saved["response"] is None
print(json.dumps({"baseline_stale_call_blocks":True,"candidate_stale_call_releases":True,
    "current_revision_still_reserves":True,"original_call_unchanged":True,
    "database":"real disposable PostgreSQL","slack":"fixture","models":"not invoked",
    "model_calls":0,"production_database_writes":0}))

"""Install qualified context overlays with a temporary company admission lease and preserved receipts."""
import fcntl
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
Q=json.loads((ROOT/"qualification.json").read_text())
CI=json.loads((ROOT/"source-ci.json").read_text())
JOURNAL=ROOT/"cutover.json"
os.umask(0o077)

def run(args,timeout=90):
    result=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError("Operator command failed: "+args[0])
    return result.stdout.strip()

def save(record):
    tmp=JOURNAL.with_suffix(".tmp")
    with tmp.open("w") as stream:
        json.dump(record,stream,indent=2)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp,JOURNAL)

def inventory():
    names=[n for n in run(["docker","ps","-a","--format","{{.Names}}"]).splitlines() if n.startswith("quant-company-")]
    return {c["Name"].lstrip("/"):c for c in json.loads(run(["docker","inspect",*names]))}

def public(containers):
    return {name:{"id":c["Id"],"image":c["Image"],"running":c["State"]["Running"]} for name,c in containers.items()}

def boundaries(old,new):
    for field in ("User","Entrypoint","Cmd","WorkingDir"):
        assert old["Config"][field]==new["Config"][field]
    assert dict(p.split("=",1) for p in old["Config"]["Env"])==dict(p.split("=",1) for p in new["Config"]["Env"])
    for field in ("ReadonlyRootfs","CapDrop","CapAdd","SecurityOpt","Memory","NanoCpus","PidsLimit","Tmpfs","RestartPolicy"):
        assert old["HostConfig"][field]==new["HostConfig"][field]
    assert sorted((m["Type"],m["Source"],m["Destination"],m["RW"]) for m in old["Mounts"])==sorted(
        (m["Type"],m["Source"],m["Destination"],m["RW"]) for m in new["Mounts"])
    assert set(old["NetworkSettings"]["Networks"])==set(new["NetworkSettings"]["Networks"])

def source_hash(name,path):
    code="import hashlib;from pathlib import Path;print(hashlib.sha256(Path("+repr("/app/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/quant_company/"+path)+").read_bytes()).hexdigest())"
    return run(["docker","exec",name,"python","-c",code])

assert CI["headRefOid"]==Q["patch_commit"]
assert {c["name"] for c in CI["statusCheckRollup"]}=={"service","codex-protocol"}
assert all(c["status"]=="COMPLETED" and c["conclusion"]=="SUCCESS" for c in CI["statusCheckRollup"])
assert Q["comparison"]["candidate"]["frozen_context"]["all_ranges_visible"]
assert Q["comparison"]["candidate"]["requested_file"]["context_with_requested_test"]["all_ranges_visible"]
assert Q["comparison"]["candidate"]["filename_lookup_returns_requested_code"]
assert Q["revision_guard"]["candidate_stale_call_releases"]
assert Q["revision_guard"]["current_revision_still_reserves"]
assert Q["revision_guard"]["original_call_unchanged"]
with Path("/var/lib/quant-company/.backup.lock").open("a") as backup:
    fcntl.flock(backup,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    assert not JOURNAL.exists(),"Reconcile the saved effect receipt; do not replay"
    locker=subprocess.Popen(["docker","exec","-i","-u","postgres","quant-company-postgres-1",
        "psql","-XqAt","-v","ON_ERROR_STOP=1","-d","quant_company"],
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,bufsize=1)
    def query(sql):
        locker.stdin.write(sql+";\n")
        locker.stdin.flush()
        result=locker.stdout.readline().strip()
        if not result:
            raise RuntimeError("Database boundary query failed")
        return json.loads(result)
    held=[]
    record=None
    pause_before=None
    pause_until=None
    try:
        assert query("SELECT jsonb_build_object('acquired',pg_try_advisory_lock(71350221))")["acquired"]
        before=inventory()
        for key,target in Q["targets"].items():
            old=before[target["name"]]
            assert old["Id"]==target["id"] and old["Image"]==target["base_image_id"] and old["State"]["Running"]
            for module in (["admission"] if key=="worker" else ["admission","github","runner","investigation"]):
                assert source_hash(target["name"],"maintenance/"+module+".py")==Q["base_modules"][module]
            assert json.loads(run(["docker","image","inspect",Q["images"][key]["tag"]]))[0]["Id"]==Q["images"][key]["id"]
        providers={}
        for name,var in [("quant-company-codex-runtime-1","CODEX_JOBS_DIR")]:
            c=before[name]
            env=dict(p.split("=",1) for p in c["Config"]["Env"])
            dest=env[var]
            m=next(m for m in c["Mounts"] if dest==m["Destination"] or dest.startswith(m["Destination"].rstrip("/")+"/"))
            path=Path(m["Source"]+dest[len(m["Destination"]):]+"/.runtime.lock")
            assert m["Type"]=="bind" and path.exists()
            providers[name]=path
        pause_before=query("SELECT COALESCE(to_jsonb(paused_until),'null'::jsonb) FROM runtime_control WHERE id=1")
        assert pause_before is None, "Respect an existing owner/provider pause"
        pause_until=query("SELECT to_jsonb(now()+interval '5 minutes')")
        record={"state":"pause_intended","started_at":datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
            "patch_commit":Q["patch_commit"],"pause_before":pause_before,"pause_until":pause_until,
            "before":public(before),"scope":"maintenance context/read producer-consumer and current diagnostic admission guard"}
        save(record)
        applied=query("WITH changed AS (UPDATE runtime_control SET paused_until='"+pause_until+"'::timestamptz WHERE id=1 AND paused_until IS NULL RETURNING paused_until) SELECT to_jsonb(paused_until) FROM changed")
        assert applied==pause_until
        record.update(state="company_admission_paused",pause_applied_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat())
        save(record)
        print(json.dumps({"state":"waiting_for_completed_company_call_boundary","at":datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()}),flush=True)
        start=time.monotonic()
        while time.monotonic()-start<120:
            try:
                for path in providers.values():
                    stream=path.open("r+")
                    held.append(stream)
                    fcntl.flock(stream,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
                break
            except BlockingIOError:
                for stream in held:
                    stream.close()
                held=[]
                time.sleep(1)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("Existing calls still active; no service replaced")
        # The CLI lock is released after saving its receipt; let its worker commit normally.
        for _ in range(60):
            running=query("SELECT to_jsonb(count(*)) FROM turns t JOIN tasks k ON k.id=t.task_id JOIN projects p ON p.id=k.project_id WHERE t.status='running' AND k.revision=p.revision")
            if running==0:
                break
            time.sleep(1)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("Company outcome still committing; no service replaced")
        assert query("SELECT to_jsonb(count(*)) FROM maintenance_calls c JOIN maintenance_jobs j ON j.id=c.job_id WHERE c.response IS NULL AND j.state IN ('review','triage','patch','design','evaluate','publish')")==0
        # Claude is serving the separate video worker. New company/staff calls honor runtime_control.
        # Reject a recent running receipt from a company/staff caller before stopping its worker.
        claude_calls=[]
        for path in Path("/var/lib/quant-company/claude/jobs").glob("*.json"):
            if path.stat().st_mtime<time.time()-1800:
                continue
            try:
                receipt=json.loads(path.read_text())
            except (OSError,ValueError):
                continue
            if receipt.get("state")=="running":
                identity=receipt.get("request_id","")
                assert identity.startswith("video-"), "A related Claude outcome is still running"
                claude_calls.append(identity)
        current=inventory()
        assert public(current)==public(before),"Another operator changed a container; reconcile first"
        release=str(Path("/opt/quant-company/current").resolve())
        original_sql="SELECT jsonb_build_object('jobs',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'digest',md5(to_jsonb(j)::text)) ORDER BY id) FROM maintenance_jobs j WHERE id IN ('672a94ca-b8e9-51b7-8fb0-354b96c7f355','c7d07401-ef8a-5d16-96f5-b6048b16dd1b')),'calls',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'digest',md5(to_jsonb(c)::text)) ORDER BY id) FROM maintenance_calls c WHERE job_id IN ('672a94ca-b8e9-51b7-8fb0-354b96c7f355','c7d07401-ef8a-5d16-96f5-b6048b16dd1b')))"
        originals=query(original_sql)
        frozen=query("SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'digest',md5(request::text)) ORDER BY id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM turns WHERE request IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('queued','waiting','running')")
        commands={}
        for key,target in Q["targets"].items():
            old=before[target["name"]]
            env=dict(p.split("=",1) for p in old["Config"]["Env"])
            override=Path("/var/lib/quant-company/config")/("maintainer-continuity-"+Q["patch_commit"]+"-"+key+".compose.json")
            override.write_text(json.dumps({"services":{target["service"]:{
                "image":Q["images"][key]["tag"],"environment":env,
                "mem_limit":old["HostConfig"]["Memory"],"cpus":old["HostConfig"]["NanoCpus"]/1e9}}}))
            command=["docker","compose","--project-name",target["project"],"--profile","*","--env-file",target["envfile"]]
            for file in target["compose_files"].split(",")+[str(override)]:
                command+=["-f",file]
            resolved=json.loads(run(command+["config","--format","json"]))["services"][target["service"]]
            assert resolved["image"]==Q["images"][key]["tag"]
            assert {k:str(v) for k,v in resolved["environment"].items()}==env
            commands[key]=command
        record.update(state="cutover_started",ci=CI,global_release=release,
            original_cases=originals,frozen_company_requests=frozen,
            inference_locks_held_after_existing_calls_completed=list(providers),
            unrelated_claude_video_calls=claude_calls)
        save(record)
        for key in ("worker","maintenance"):
            run(["docker","stop","--time","60",Q["targets"][key]["name"]],timeout=90)
        for key in ("maintenance","worker"):
            target=Q["targets"][key]
            run(commands[key]+["up","-d","--no-deps","--no-build","--pull","never",target["service"]],timeout=180)
        after=inventory()
        changed={t["name"] for t in Q["targets"].values()}
        for key,target in Q["targets"].items():
            new=after[target["name"]]
            assert new["State"]["Running"] and not new["State"]["OOMKilled"]
            assert new["Image"]==Q["images"][key]["id"]
            boundaries(before[target["name"]],new)
            for module in (["admission"] if key=="worker" else ["admission","github","runner","investigation"]):
                assert source_hash(target["name"],"maintenance/"+module+".py")==Q["candidate_modules"][module]
        assert query(original_sql)==originals
        if frozen:
            ids=",".join("'"+r["id"]+"'" for r in frozen)
            saved=query("SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'digest',md5(request::text)) ORDER BY id) FROM turns WHERE id IN ("+ids+")")
            assert saved==frozen
        assert all(public(after)[name]==value for name,value in public(before).items() if name not in changed)
        assert str(Path("/opt/quant-company/current").resolve())==release
        record.update(state="active",completed_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),after=public(after),
            original_cases_and_calls_unchanged=True,frozen_company_requests_unchanged=True,
            environment_and_boundaries_unchanged=True,other_containers_unchanged=True,
            model_calls_by_operator=0,global_admission_pause=True,models_effort_caps_and_slots_unchanged=True)
        save(record)
    except BaseException as error:
        if record is not None:
            record.update(state="requires_operator_reconciliation",error_type=type(error).__name__)
            save(record)
        raise
    finally:
        if pause_until is not None:
            restored=query("WITH changed AS (UPDATE runtime_control SET paused_until=NULL WHERE id=1 AND paused_until='"+pause_until+"'::timestamptz RETURNING id) SELECT to_jsonb(count(*)) FROM changed")
            if record is not None:
                record.update(company_admission_restored=(restored==1),
                    pause_restored_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
                    pause_database_writes=2 if restored==1 else 1)
                save(record)
        for stream in held:
            stream.close()
        locker.stdin.close()
        locker.wait(timeout=10)
    if record is not None and record["state"]=="active":
        print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
